newsitem.title: UK: UK gas output up 22.9 pct June-Aug, oil up 6.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: UK gas output up 22.9 pct June-Aug, oil up 6.1 pct.

text.p: Britain's gas output rose by 22.9 percent in the three months June to August compared to the same period a year ago, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said on Tuesday.

Oil output was up by 6.1 percent in the same period. Oil production rose 30 percent in June compared to June 1995, which the DTI said reflected a more even spread of North Sea maintenance work this year while there was a heavy concentration in June last year.
Total production of primary fuels -- oil, coal and gas -- reached 60.4 million tonnes of oil equivalent in the three months, up 6.2 percent
While gas and oil production was up, output of coal fell by 7.1 percent.
Production of primary electricity, defined by the DTI as nuclear electricity and natural flow hydro electricity, fell by 7.3 percent.
